method: BFS over resolved static/re-export/dynamic imports from system.json esmodules; template-literal dynamic imports expanded as glob patterns from reachable importers; non-JS files reached via manifest entries or path strings in runtime referrers (JS reachable from index.js, templates, styles, packs, lang, non-audit data, system.json/template.json). Zero static importers is NOT treated as proof of dead code.
